entry_inventory.interpretation: Name inventory only; not complete parameter, numerical or project migration compatibility

wire.layout: p=min(m,n); Q(m,p),R(p,n) or U(m,p),S(p,p),V(n,p), each row-major; S is diagonal
wire.local_shape_policy: Official docs specify identities/names but not rectangular full versus compact sizes; no Google shape claim
wire.boundary: SVD8x4 and4x8 each64 outputs; QR7x5 has60 outputs

native_numeric.QR: Hypot column norms, Householder reflections and exact-decimal dot/update products with explicit finite binary64 outputs. Enforced input-sensitive precision/scale envelope; no universal completeness proof.
native_numeric.SVD: Raw pinned Commons Math3.6.1 primary factors must pass exact dyadic integer rank, all active Gram elementary spectral coefficients, finite/sorted/nonnegative singulars, orthogonality and normwise backward-error checks. Invalid primary factors use at most32 MC80 half-even one-sided Jacobi sweeps; same validators remain mandatory. Wide inputs transpose and swap factors.
native_numeric.rank: Full row/column pivot Bareiss rank on a common dyadic integer scale, with32768-bit intermediate bound; exact rank identifies null directions, not a floating near-zero threshold.
native_numeric.Jacobi: 80-digit working coefficients; products <=160 digits, addition alignment <=162; independent absolute scale ceiling65536 applies only to refinement. Exact rank/Gram/output spectrum stay on original separately priced input/output bounds. Scale ceiling is enforced resource policy, not proof every representable decomposition completes.
native_numeric.validation: Native safety gates use1e-10 orthogonality/normwise/spectral relative tolerances. Extreme tiny singular references separately require positive values and relative accuracy; normwise reconstruction does not prove elementwise relative accuracy or universal tiny-sigma fidelity.
native_numeric.masks: Any NaN or failed/nonfinite factor masks the whole group; source Infinity rejects even next to missing peers. Existing terminal Float32 cast can overflow to Infinity; source-free fold rejects nonfinite final cast.

implementation.folding: Static Array QR/SVD now supports compact rectangular shapes after unchanged precharge policy (square charges unchanged); NumPy/LAPACK retained. Source-free Image fold separately precharges exact dyadic Bareiss rank and canonicalizes true null tail to zero, rejecting missing positive singulars. No invented grid or native acceptance from folding.
implementation.factor_snapshot: Only designated root-scope Cholesky/LU/QR/SVD SDK ValueRefs cache, up to500 entries. Prove immutable Pixel/Source/tuple descendants; detach plain JSON metadata at storage and every restore, precharge all work. Mapped/typed/joined/unknown/mutable/cyclic values skip caching. Reset each root evaluation; no numerical pixels or actual catalog/grid facts cached.

admission.method: Fold scalar source exponent/significand envelope and key count, precharge separate exact rank/Gram/output products, MC80 iterations, conversion and conservative copies; recheck each output tile before factor allocation. Wide work uses max(m,n). Commons square workspace allowance is deliberately conservative; actual library uses compact factors. RDD path reviewed statically, not executed.
admission.qr8x4_extreme: rejected by1e8 admission; direct kernel only checked separately
admission.scope: Sample-specific work calibration, not throughput. Default256-square tiles fail these ordinary SVD estimates; production layout adaptation remains unimplemented/unverified.

implementation.modularity: Separate wire/layout, compiler/folding, immutable root reuse, exact rank, QR, SVD validation, Jacobi, admission and workflow/reference modules. No new numerical dependency or runtime deployment.

full_pytest.scope: Required loopback/process/macOS sandbox permissions; original application boundaries intact. Runtime sources unchanged. Two test files later had EOF blank lines removed with identical ASTs and focused tests passing; pre-format hashes retained in local full-suite evidence.
